title: Opening of the tape and a trumpet lip exercise for Rolf Wall
summary: Guesnon announces the date and place of the recording at his home and introduces his Swedish visitor Rolf Wall, then starts a chromatic lip-warming exercise.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
